locator: Definitions of Gross Bookings, Trips and Monthly Active Platform Consumers
text: Gross Bookings includes applicable taxes, tolls and fees and excludes tips. Trips comprises Mobility rides and Delivery orders. MAPCs is the monthly unique Mobility/Delivery consumer count averaged over the quarter, counting a consumer once despite multiple product use. It is not a count of all distinct consumers across the entire quarter.
